description_en:
Xianyan provides you with OpenAPI operations that deliver the same conversational experience as the official console. By simply passing parameters such as workspaceId and query, you can perform Q&A and data analytics on your pre-created workspace.

This API operation is suitable for the following scenario:  
You have associated a data source in the Xianyan console, allowing Xianyan to access your database and execute SQL queries either over the Internet or through a VPC.

For detailed usage instructions, refer to the following Best Practices document:  
https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/gbi-best-practices
description_zh:
析言为您提供了与官方页面对话效果相同的OpenAPI接口，只需传入workspaceId以及query等相关信息，即可对您已经创建好的业务空间进行问答和数据分析。

该接口适合以下场景：
您在析言控制台关联了数据源，即析言可以通过公网或者VPC的方式访问您的数据库并执行SQL。

具体的使用，可以参考以下最佳实践文档：
https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/gbi-best-practices
kebab_example: aliyun dataanalysisgbi run-data-analysis --workspace-id llm-2v3934xtp49esw64 --specification-type STANDARD_MIX --generate-sql-only true --query '请问销量前十的产品有哪些' --session-id sessionID --data-role 管理员 --user-params shopId_:_1_,_2_,_userId_:_10001 --agent-ctrl-params withoutRewrite_:_true,_withoutVisualization_:_true,_enableChatMode_:_true --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunDataAnalysis
